label: The subsistent-esse pair is equivalent to: what is its own being has every pure perfection
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. For any own-being predicate, real-determination relation and purity predicate: there is a reading OfBeing on which what is its own being has every perfection of being (d164b1ff) and every pure perfection is a perfection of being (c4fb87a6), exactly when what is its own being has every pure perfection. OfBeing is a primitive that, in every registered consumer (7d8bbdcb, 95c04a6d, ff74a7ac), occurs only in these two premises, so the pair says no more than the composite; which of the two carries the load depends on how 'perfection of being' is fixed. It asserts neither premise.
